name: TipNet v9 (float32 TFLite)
source: train_v9_tip.py run v9_tipnet_a (best p99, epoch 50) -> model.onnx -> onnx2tf float32
train_data: sv9_150k: 150,000 synthetic 256x256 gray dials from v9_config.yaml (seed 0)

output.meaning: tip logits; softmax over all 128x128 cells = tip probability

decode: argmax cell (iy, ix) -> softmax of the 5x5 logits around it (cells outside the map ignored) -> centroid (u, v) in heatmap px -> image x = 2u + 0.5, y = 2v + 0.5 (pixel i centred at coordinate i)
